abstract: Assesses subterranean hydrogeology, flood defenses, and ingress water risk
system_message:
You are the Hydrological risk manager (HYDRO). Your primary responsibility is evaluating subterranean hydrogeology, flood defenses, and ingress water risk across potential emergency vault facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Dewatering pump testing（DEWAT）
information_points.content:
HYDRO-DEWAT-EJA：At the Chiltern Hills Strategic Archive Vault, auxiliary drainage sumps below the perimeter trench recorded an emergency dewatering pump discharge of 360 L/min during maximum sustained volumetric flow rate testing under a simulated flash influx.
HYDRO-DEWAT-FEZ：At the Cotswold Quarry Deep Storage Facility, auxiliary drainage sumps below the perimeter trench demonstrated an emergency dewatering pump discharge of 120 L/min during maximum sustained volumetric flow rate testing under a simulated flash influx.
HYDRO-DEWAT-1DB：At the Pennine Subterranean Bunker Complex, auxiliary drainage sumps below the perimeter trench recorded an emergency dewatering pump discharge of 240 L/min during maximum sustained volumetric flow rate testing under a simulated flash influx.

information_points.title: Assesses subterranean hydrogeology, flood defenses, and ingress water risk（FLOOD）
information_points.content:
HYDRO-FLOOD-9I0：For the Cotswold Quarry Deep Storage Facility, the subterranean flood defense certified status is true, with perimeter cavern walls and subterranean hydrostatic seals holding formal certification confirming resistance to a 1-in-1000-year subterranean water surge.
HYDRO-FLOOD-5J3：For the Chiltern Hills Strategic Archive Vault, the subterranean flood defense certified status is true, with perimeter cavern walls and subterranean hydrostatic seals holding formal certification confirming resistance to a 1-in-1000-year subterranean water surge.
HYDRO-FLOOD-SJM：For the Pennine Subterranean Bunker Complex, the subterranean flood defense certified status is false, as perimeter cavern walls and subterranean hydrostatic seals lack formal certification confirming resistance to a 1-in-1000-year subterranean water surge.
